capabilities: transform jw.org links into JW Library-compatible links
transform a selected link via the 'JW Relink: Transform link' command
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Links copied from JW.ORG do not open in JW Library, so users must rework them by hand.
summary: Link transformer that converts jw.org links into a format that opens in the JW Library app.
